objective: Prove a shared abstract resource stays locked through review and unlocks only after acceptance, without repository or cloud mutation.
constraints: Both tasks share the abstract resource score-canary-lane; the second must wait until the first is accepted.
No repository:write, no cloud:change, no absolute host paths.
Fixed non-LLM handlers only; no secrets in evidence.

tasks.title: Hold the lane through build and review
tasks.instructions: Write score-runs/{run_id}/resource-lock-first.json under the shared lane lease. Return path and sha256. Release the lane only after independent acceptance.

tasks.title: Acquire the lane after first acceptance
tasks.instructions: After SRL-first is accepted, write score-runs/{run_id}/resource-lock-second.json on the same abstract lane. Confirm the lane was not usable before acceptance. Return path and sha256.
